import html # Template for rendering a blog post. Placeholders: {title} and {body} BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post safely for inclusion in an HTML page. Parameters ---------- title : str The user‑supplied title of the post. body : str The user‑supplied main content of the post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the title and body properly escaped to prevent XSS. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(body, str): raise TypeError("Both title and body must be strings") # Escape all user input to neutralize any HTML/JS that might have been injected. safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
